issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared across all SealSaloon instances), but in the solution SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice is implemented as an instance method (non-static). This contradicts the specification about method staticness and may confuse students about how to access the method and how it should interact with the shared static stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice static to match the specification: change its declaration to public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and ensure it uses the static stock field. Update any calls if necessary (calling it via SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice or allowing instance calls with the static method). This preserves the intended design where price calculation uses the shared stock.
